name: Meia G
description: Meia G is a Brazilian-born artist working in New York. His paintings operate as spatial systems rather than images — chrome and controlled black grounds used to expose the instability of perception.
$customDomain: Leave null until the domain is ready to move. Setting it writes dist/CNAME, at which point GitHub Pages serves only that domain and redirects the github.io preview URL to it — which looks broken while meia-g.art still points at Squarespace. Set to "www.meia-g.art" as the last step.
$hero: The painting the landing page opens with — R-01-06, the same one meia-g.art uses.
$shareImage: The painting used for link previews (og:image) — deliberately not the hero. Messages and other apps tint the caption bar under the card with a colour sampled from the image, and R-01-06 carries bright warm highlights (7.4% of its pixels are saturated, averaging rgb 121,92,68), which renders as a brown bar. R-02-03 measures 30,30,27 with 0.5% faint colour, so the bar stays black. Re-measure before changing this: the test is the share of bright saturated pixels, not the overall mean.
$seriesCovers: Cover image per series on the Work index, matching the covers meia-g.art uses for its three projects.
